The company said the loan consists of $550M funded at closing and an additional $50M delayed draw commitment available for up to 12 months, and it can establish a super-priority revolving credit facility of as much as $75M, creating a total financing package of as much as $675M.

said it plans to use the proceeds primarily for payment obligations under its turbine asset purchase agreement, including construction of the proposed 460 MW Turtle Creek project, which has an estimated total cost of less than $800M.
The company said the loan facilities represent the largest component of its overall financing plan for Turtle Creek and address the majority of the project's expected capital requirements.
Combined with operating cash flow expected to generate before the start of commercial operation of Turtle Creek, Hallador
